'''N'Kata Del Gormo''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hysalrian/Legends|Hysalrian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who lived during the [[Great Peace of the Republic]]. According to legend, he found and trained [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and a Force-sensitive [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Unidentified Force-sensitive Human|friend]].

==Biography==
[[File:Gibi_news_yoda.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Legend had it that Yoda&mdash;a Jedi who became Grand Master&mdash;was trained by N'Kata Del Gormo.]]
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Hysalrian/Legends|Hysalrian]], N'Kata Del Gormo was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and achieved the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The four-limbed, serpentine Jedi also had crafted a staff imbued with a large crystal at its summit.<ref name="DAA" /> According to legend,<ref name="Twitter" /> N'Kata Del Gormo was residing on a [[Unidentified swamp planet|swamp world]] when two visitors crossed his path. A young hermit named [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Unidentified Force-sensitive Human|friend]] had crash-landed on the world and came to Del Gormo for assistance. After a couple of days, Master Del Gormo met with the duo and informed them that they were in fact Force-sensitive, offering to train them as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]].<ref name="DAA" />

The legend continues that later, a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] landed on the planet, answering the distress call that had been sent from Yoda's ship before the crash. Departing the world, Yoda went to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he continued his training at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], eventually ascending to the rank of [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]].<ref name="DAA" /> If those events did happen, their dates were lost during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], when the self-anointed [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] exterminated the Jedi Order.<ref name="NFF2">{{FactFile2013|2|YOD 1-4|Yoda}}</ref>

==Equipment==
Although N'Kata Del Gormo went about mostly [[Clothing/Legends|unclothed]], he wore a [[Leather/Legends|leather]] [[Harness/Legends|harness]] made of two straps that crossed his upper torso. He also had a [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]] with a large pouch on either side, and wore ornamental [[Vambrace/Legends|vambraces]] on each of his four wrists. He wielded a long, twisted [[Staff/Legends|staff]] crowned with a [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] prism.<ref name="DAA" />

==Behind the scenes==
N'Kata Del Gormo was created by [[Chuck Hamilton]], a ''[[Star Wars]]'' fan, for the backstory of his [[Hysalrian]] entry in the [[Design An Alien]] contest held in the ''[[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine]]''.<ref name="DAA" /> [[Leland Chee]], who maintains the [[Holocron continuity database]], established that the character was part of continuity except for his time on Dagobah, on the [[StarWars.com]] Message Boards in [[2006]].<ref name="Chee Boards">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?messageID=14866609#14864813|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-05-22|time=1:31 PM}}</ref> He later explained that Del Gormo's backstory as the Jedi Master of Yoda is regarded as an [[in-universe]] legend in a [[2013]] Twitter post.<ref name="Twitter" />
